caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet with a prominent, large bow placed on the top right, featuring distinctive stripes and a checked pattern. The bonnet appears to be made of a woven fabric, suggested by crosshatch marks throughout the surface. There is a frilled edge along the back and bottom, and a striped ribbon runs down vertically from the side, ending in a trailing loose bow or tie. The ribbon and bow both have alternating bands of lighter and darker shades. The drawing is rendered in monochrome, using shades of black, gray, and white, with visible pencil or ink lines and washes for shading and detail. The entire composition is presented on a plain, uncolored background.
title: Bonnet
